title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 019
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute VIP and attachment variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Diamond badge outline with a centered downward chevron
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a premium badge formed as a diamond with an inner chevron.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for crowns or V badges when the outer diamond frame matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the only selected VIP icon with a diamond border around an inner chevron.

items.depicts_observation: Crown outline with three rounded tips and a wide base line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a premium symbol that reads as a crown rather than a letter shaped badge.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the diamond or V marks when the crown form is the visible cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot switches from badge geometry to a clear three tip crown silhouette.

items.depicts_observation: Wide V badge outline with a centered notch at the top
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a sharp V shaped premium badge without an added jewel.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the jeweled V badge when the top center should remain open and plain.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is a plain wide V shape with a small top notch and no added diamond.

items.depicts_observation: V badge outline with a small top diamond shape at center
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the V shaped premium badge that carries a small diamond jewel cue.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain V badge when the top diamond ornament should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a diamond jewel at the top center of the same V shaped frame.

items.depicts_observation: Upright paper clip with a vertical outer loop and inner loop
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a paper clip drawn vertically instead of diagonally or hooked open.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the diagonal clips when the vertical upright orientation matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot stands the paper clip upright with a tall outer loop and centered inner loop.
